evals.expected_output: Starts at docs/c/01-intro.md (not jumping to 03). Log file is .result/student-brain(c-to-03-variables-operators).md. Sequential chapters until stuck or through 03. On confusion: detailed Stop + halt. Short polite chat.
assertions: Creates .result/student-brain(c-to-03-variables-operators).md (or scoped copy under outputs/), not bare student-brain.md
